main_text.l: Facultas ualde imbecilla, & calor igneus:Parvos, tardos, & creberrimos.
Modice imbecilla, & calor igneus:Aeque crebros: sed in distensione & motu, moderatos.
Facultas imbecilla, & refrigeratio:Parvos, tardos, sed non creberrimos.
Calor & facultas: increscentes:Quàm vehementissimos, maximos: sed non celerrimos, neque creberrimos aperte.
Facultatis robur, & caloris defectus:Moderatos, magnos, tardiores, & bene rarðs: maximè, vbi polleat refrigeratio.
Arteriæ fola mollities, seclusis aliis caufis, paritMaiores, celeriores, & raros.
Durities cum caloris innati refrigeratione:Minores iusto, & tardiores.
Duritiés refrigeratione superior:Minores quàm tardiores, crebriores.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The line "Parvos" in the scan reads "Paruos"; "Tardiores" at the foot is set in italic. Word "rarðs" at the end of the paragraph beginning "Facultatis robur" is a doubtful reading of "rarös:"; the scan shows "ros:" after a hyphenated "ra-", so it should read "rarös:".
